description: Ministry of Agriculture and Plantation Industries - Control of Pesticides Act, No.33 of 1980, Amended Extra Gazette No.1113/15 of 05.01.2000
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister under the Control of Pesticides Act, No. 33 of 1980, specifically amending existing regulations and setting fees for certificates and training. This falls under "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" as it involves subsidiary legislation and regulatory compliance requirements. While a minister's name is mentioned, the primary content is regulatory amendment, not government personnel or structural changes, so specialized Type 5 takes precedence over government-related types.
